svg.text: NVIDIA inference optimization SDK - docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/tensorrt - build phase + runtime phase
L1 - Framework Integration + Workloads (production GPU inference - graph compile to .engine deployment)
L2 - Two-Phase Model (offline build compiles graph - runtime deserializes engine - strongly typed default TRT 10+)
Layer + Tensor graph - ONNX import or add* API
Engine outlives Builder after build completes
L3 - API Surface (parsers - layers - builder config - plugins - LLM attention layers)
Parser owns weight memory until build done
Strongly typed networks default since TRT 10
BuilderFlag FP16 BF16 INT8 FP8 FP4 precision
Workspace / memory pool limits per layer
Tactic sources + timing cache for rebuild speed
Optimization profiles for dynamic input shapes
Multiple contexts per engine for parallelism
I/O binding query tensor names dims dtypes
Ragged kPACKED_NHD batching for variable seqlen
QDP Quick Deployable Plugins - weight streaming
L4 - Build Optimization Pipeline (import - graph rewrite - tactic select - serialize engine)
ONNX parse or programmatic layer construction
Explicit Q/DQ layers for INT8/FP8 quant
Per-layer dtype via strongly typed network
Profile CUDA kernels per layer on target GPU
Engine plan embeds chosen tactics + weights
L5 - Runtime Libraries + Kernel Backends (libnvinfer variants - cuDNN/cuBLAS/CUTLASS tactics)
Load older lean runtime for plan compat
Template GEMM tactics + TRT native kernels
Capture engine execution for low latency
L6 - Package Layout (github.com/NVIDIA/TensorRT - parser/ plugin/ samples/ python/ cpp/ - NVIDIA SDK)
Engine Build Execution Path (offline compile - ONNX to .engine plan)
Builder eliminates dead ops - fuses layers - profiles tactics - serializes optimized plan for target GPU
Step 1: Export trained model to ONNX from PyTorch/TF/JAX framework
Step 2: OnnxParser populates NetworkDefinition - resolve custom ops via PluginRegistry
Step 3: BuilderConfig set FP16/INT8 flags + optimization profiles + workspace limit
Step 4: Builder graph fusion + tactic autotune per layer - timing cache for rebuild
Step 5: build_serialized_network - save .engine - deploy with Runtime + ExecutionContext
Runtime: deserialize engine - create ExecutionContext - setTensorAddress - enqueueV3
One TRT engine layer may fuse multiple ONNX ops - Conv+Bias+ReLU into single CUDA kernel
Lean runtime for production deploy - dispatch shim loads older plan on newer TRT version
NVIDIA inference graph compiler - sits above cuDNN/cuBLAS - consumed by Triton and TensorRT-LLM
trt.Builder - OnnxParser - BuilderConfig FP16 - build_serialized_network - save .engine
Design Position (NVIDIA inference graph compiler - offline build + lean runtime = peak GPU inference throughput)
Layer fusion + tactic autotune + mixed precision + .engine plan = default NVIDIA production inference deploy path
Init: export ONNX - create Builder + NetworkDefinition - configure BuilderConfig - build engine (minutes)
Loop: deserialize engine - ExecutionContext - setTensorAddress - enqueueV3 - optional CUDA Graph capture
